title: PanelContext feeds panel/plugin state into grafana-ui viz internals
answers: How do panels pass selection state/event bus into grafana-ui visualization components?
body: `PanelContext` is defined inside grafana-ui itself at `packages/grafana-ui/src/components/PanelChrome/PanelContext.ts:103`, with `usePanelContext` at line 116, exported publicly via src/index.ts:181-184. Panels/plugins wrap children in `PanelContextProvider` to push data (selection state, event bus, etc.) down; visualization internals read it back out with `usePanelContext`. Unlike ThemeContext, this context's provider and definition both live in grafana-ui — the app/plugin side only supplies the value.
